subject: Air traces, sensor lag, clock errors, device error, package variability, and different measurement locations can create misleading apparent contradictions.
rationale: S005 supports the risk that unreliable evidence misleads comparisons. T001 makes measurement comparability relevant: room logs, single-package readings, and differing receiving methods measure different aspects of deliveries. Air and package temperatures can differ; sensor lag and clock errors can misplace changes in time; device error, package variability, and measurement location can produce discrepancies unrelated to an explanation's truth. These mechanisms justify the modest 'can' limitation without establishing that any distortion occurred or its magnitude.
